noFieldDesc: Pick a field to create reproducible feature runs: daily, monthly, seasonal and crop-season aggregations with baselines, anomalies and drought/heat indicators.
createFirst: Create a farm and field first.
mainDesc: Versioned feature definitions · reproducible runs · full provenance to source observations
createDesc: Derived features are computed from ONE source per variable (products are never blended). Coverage below a definition's minimum leaves the value explicitly empty — missing data is never treated as zero.
seasonWindowsDesc: Windows are recorded verbatim in run provenance. Crop calendars from the sourced knowledge base arrive in a later milestone — nothing is invented here.
dailyAlertDesc: Each requested day becomes one stored value per feature. Keep daily windows to about three years per run.
indicesNote: Indices follow cited meteorological conventions (WMO dry day, ETCCDI temperature indices). Crop-specific stress thresholds remain unevaluated until the sourced crop knowledge base exists.
errDateFormat: Enter start and end as YYYY-MM-DD.
errDateOrder: The end date must be on or after the start date.
errMaxYears: A run covers at most 31 years.
errDailyLimit: Daily aggregation is limited to ~3 years per run — uncheck Daily or shorten the window.
errNoSeasons: Add at least one crop-season window or uncheck Crop seasons.
errSeasonLabel: Every crop season needs a label.
syntheticDesc: This run is computed from SYNTHETIC fixture data — values demonstrate the pipeline and are never valid for real-world conclusions.
showingValues: Showing the first {shown} of {total} values — narrow the level or window to see everything.
noValuesForLevel: No stored values for level “{level}” in this run.
noOverlap: No overlapping evaluated periods between these runs.
noRuns: No runs yet for this field.
catalogDesc: Definitions are versioned data: every value records the catalog version and formula reference it was computed with.
